name: Fixer
tagline: Foreign exchange rates and currency conversion API
description: Fixer is a foreign exchange rates and currency conversion API providing real-time and historical FX data for major and minor world currencies. It offers latest rates, historical rates by date, time-series data, currency conversion, and fluctuation endpoints for building multi-currency apps, finance dashboards, and e-commerce pricing.

auth.details: API access key as query parameter access_key=YOUR_API_KEY (or via Authorization header on some plans); self-serve signup at fixer.io

pricing.free_tier_limits: 100 requests/month free (base plan); EUR base currency only on free tier
pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans from ~$10–80+/month with higher monthly quotas, USD base, HTTPS, time-series, conversion, and more currencies

rate_limits: Monthly request quotas by plan; free ~100/month. Per-second/minute limits not prominently published
use_cases: get latest FX rates for major currencies
convert an amount between two currencies
fetch historical exchange rate for a past date
track currency fluctuation over a date range
